title: Section 6: discovery cross-validation of session owner_user_id vs WhoIs is correct
description: discovery.rs:430-440 cross-validates the peer session's claimed owner_user_id against the Tailscale-verified user_id from the /status peers list. This prevents a malicious node from serving a session with a different user_id to redirect outbound delivery. A contributor might suggest removing the check as 'redundant' since Tailscale already proves the IP. But the check is necessary: the IP proves the node, not the user_id in the JMAP response. The session owner_user_id could be fabricated. The check ensures the peer's self-reported identity matches Tailscale's record.
